description: This file defines the CartItem entity class for the shopping cart domain, including its fields, relationships, lifecycle callbacks, and basic accessor methods.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Entity representing an item in a shopping cart, associated with a Cart and containing product details and timestamps.

methods.name: CartItem
methods.description: Constructor initializing a CartItem with associated cart, product ID, and quantity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Method annotated with @PrePersist to set creation and update timestamps before persisting.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the cart item.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Returns the cart to which this item belongs.

methods.name: getQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product in the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product and updates the 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the item was created.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the item was last updated.
